# 💳 Firecrawl Knowledge Base Builder

💳 Requires a Firecrawl API key — the hosted service is paid (usage-based credits). Curated by Skill Harbor — a knowledge-base workflow with four modes: build a reference knowledge base from a site, a RAG-ready dataset, training data, or a document mirror, by crawling the site with Firecrawl and converting the content into structured, organized output. By @firecrawl, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: the output is only as good as the source site's content and crawl coverage; respect the site's terms and licenses before turning its content into a training or mirror dataset. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
